1.english_reference: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֞י מִ קֵּ֣ץ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ εἴκοσι ἔτη
traditions.VUL: Explétis autem vigínti annis
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years ,

1.english_reference: wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν οἷς οἰκοδόμησεν Σαλωμὼν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: postquam ædificávit Sálomon domum Dómini
traditions.KJV: wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בֵּיתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et domum suam :
traditions.KJV: and his own house ,

2.english_reference: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon

traditions.WLC: וְ הֶ עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς πόλεις ἃς ἔδωκεν Χειρὰμ τῷ Σαλωμών ,
traditions.VUL: civitátes , quas déderat Hiram Salomóni ,
traditions.KJV: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon ,

traditions.WLC: בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτὰς Σαλωμὼν
traditions.VUL: ædificávit
traditions.KJV: Solomon built them ,

2.english_reference: and caused the children of Israel to dwell there

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐκεῖ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et habitáre ibi fecit fílios Israel .
traditions.KJV: and caused the children of Israel to dwell there .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν Σαλωμὼν εἰς Βαισωβὰ
traditions.VUL: Abiit quoque in Emath Suba ,
traditions.KJV: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατίσχυσεν αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: et obtínuit eam .
traditions.KJV: and prevailed against it .

4.english_reference: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֥בֶן אֶת תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּ מִּדְבָּ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Θοεδομὸρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
traditions.VUL: Et ædificávit Palmýram in desérto ,
traditions.KJV: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness ,

4.english_reference: and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ כָּל עָרֵ֣י הַֽ מִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּ חֲמָֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάσας τὰς πὸλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐν Ἡμάθ .
traditions.VUL: et álias civitátes munitíssimas ædificávit in Emath .
traditions.KJV: and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .

5.english_reference: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֜בֶן אֶת בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽ עֶלְי֔וֹן וְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַ תַּחְתּ֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Βαιθωρὼμ τὴν ἄνω καὶ τὴν Βαιθωρὼμ τὴν κάτω ,
traditions.VUL: Exstruxítque Béthoron superiórem , et Béthoron inferiórem ,
traditions.KJV: Also he built Bethhoron the upper , and Bethhoron the nether ,

5.english_reference: fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars

traditions.WLC: עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּ בְרִֽיחַ
traditions.LXX: πόλεις ὀχυράς , τείχη , πύλαι καὶ μοχλοί .
traditions.VUL: civitátes murátas habéntes portas et vectes et seras :
traditions.KJV: fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars ;

6.english_reference: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶֽת בַּעֲלָ֗ת וְ אֵ֨ת כָּל עָרֵ֤י הַֽ מִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν Βαλαά , καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς αἳ ἦσαν τῷ Σαλωμών ,
traditions.VUL: Bálaath étiam et omnes urbes firmíssimas , quæ fuérunt Salomónis ,
traditions.KJV: And Baalath , and all the store cities that Solomon had ,

6.english_reference: and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ כָּל עָרֵ֣י הָ רֶ֔כֶב וְ אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַ פָּרָשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τῶν ἁρμάτων καὶ τὰς πὸλεις τῶν ἱππέων ,
traditions.VUL: cunctásque urbes quadrigárum , et urbes équitum .
traditions.KJV: and all the chariot cities , and the cities of the horsemen ,

6.english_reference: and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֣ת כָּל חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִ בְנ֤וֹת בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּ בַ לְּבָנ֔וֹן וּ בְ כֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅσα ἐπεθύμησεν Σαλωμὼν κατὰ τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Omnia quæcúmque vóluit Sálomon atque dispósuit , ædificávit in Ierúsalem , et in Líbano , et in univérsa terra potestátis suæ .
traditions.KJV: and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and throughout all the land of his dominion .

7.english_reference: As for all the people left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites

traditions.WLC: כָּל הָ֠ עָם הַ נּוֹתָ֨ר מִן הַ חִתִּ֜י וְ הָ אֱמֹרִ֤י וְ הַ פְּרִזִּי֙ וְ הַ חִוִּ֣י וְ הַ יְבוּסִ֔י
traditions.LXX: πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ καταλειφθεὶς ἀπὸ τοῦ Χετταίου καὶ τοῦ Ἀμορραίου καὶ τοῦ Φερεζαίου καὶ τοῦ Εὑαίου καὶ τοῦ Ἰεβουσαίου ,
traditions.VUL: Omnem pópulum , qui derelíctus fúerat de Hethǽis , et Amorrhǽis , et Pherezǽis , et Hevǽis , et Iebusǽis ,
traditions.KJV: [ As for ] all the people [ that were ] left of the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה
traditions.LXX: οἳ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: qui non erant de stirpe Israel :
traditions.KJV: which [ were ] not of Israel ,

8.english_reference: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not

traditions.WLC: מִן בְּנֵי הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵי הֶם֙ בָּ אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא כִלּ֖וּ ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῶν τῶν καταλειφθέντων μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ γῇ οὓς ἐξωλέθρευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: de fíliis eórum , et de pósteris , quos non interfécerant fílii Israel ,
traditions.KJV: [ But ] of their children , who were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel consumed not ,

8.english_reference: them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲלֵ֤ ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ מַ֔ס עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς Σαλωμὼν εἰς φόρον ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: subiugávit Sálomon in tributários , usque in diem hanc .
traditions.KJV: them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day .

9.english_reference: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work

traditions.WLC: וּ מִן בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַ עֲבָדִ֖ים לִ מְלַאכְתּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ οὐκ ἔδωκεν Σαλωμὼν εἰς παῖδας τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Porro de fíliis Israel non pósuit ut servírent opéribus regis :
traditions.KJV: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work ;

9.english_reference: but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen

traditions.WLC: כִּי הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְ שָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔י ו וְ שָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖ וֹ וּ פָרָשָֽׁי ו
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες πολεμισταὶ καὶ ἄρχοντες , καὶ οἱ δυνατοὶ καὶ ἄρχοντες ἁρμάτων καὶ ἱππέων .
traditions.VUL: ipsi enim erant viri bellatóres , et duces primi , et príncipes quadrigárum et équitum eius .
traditions.KJV: but they [ were ] men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .

10.english_reference: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י ה נציבים אֲשֶׁר לַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ מָאתָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν προστατῶν βασιλέως Σαλωμών , πεντήκοντα καὶ διακόσιοι
traditions.VUL: Omnes autem príncipes exércitus regis Salomónis fuérunt ducénti quinquagínta ,
traditions.KJV: And these [ were ] the chief of king Solomon ’s officers , [ even ] two hundred and fifty ,

10.english_reference: that bare rule over the people

traditions.WLC: הָ רֹדִ֖ים בָּ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἐργοδιωκτοῦντες ἐν τῷ λαῷ .
traditions.VUL: qui erudiébant pópulum .
traditions.KJV: that bare rule over the people .

11.english_reference: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בַּת פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֶעֱלָ֤ה שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֵ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד לַ בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה לָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν θυγατέρα Φαραὼ Σαλωμὼν ἀνήγαγεν ἐκ πόλεως Δαυεὶδ εἰς τὸν οἶκον ὃν ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτῇ ,
traditions.VUL: Fíliam vero Pharaónis tránstulit de civitáte David in domum , quam ædificáverat ei .
traditions.KJV: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: Dixit enim rex :
traditions.KJV: for he said ,

11.english_reference: My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel

traditions.WLC: לֹא תֵשֵׁ֨ב אִשָּׁ֥ה לִ י֙ בְּ בֵית֙ דָּוִ֣יד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Οὐ κατοικήσει ἡ γυνή μου ἐν πόλει Δαυεὶδ τοῦ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Non habitábit uxor mea in domo David regis Israel ,
traditions.KJV: My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: כִּי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔מָּה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἅγιός ἐστιν
traditions.VUL: eo quod sanctificáta sit :
traditions.KJV: because [ the places are ] holy ,

11.english_reference: whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר בָּֽאָ֥ה אֲלֵי הֶ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὗ εἰσῆλθεν ἐκεῖ κιβωτὸς Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: quia ingréssa est in eam arca Dómini .
traditions.KJV: whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come .

12.english_reference: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז הֶעֱלָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה עֹל֖וֹת לַ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Τότε ἀνήνεγκεν Σαλωμὼν ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ
traditions.VUL: Tunc óbtulit Sálomon holocáusta Dómino
traditions.KJV: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD

12.english_reference: on the altar of the LORD , which he had built before the porch

traditions.WLC: עַ֚ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה לִ פְנֵ֥י הָ אוּלָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ὃ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἀπέναντι τοῦ ναοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: super altáre Dómini , quod exstrúxerat ante pórticum ,
traditions.KJV: on the altar of the LORD , which he had built before the porch ,

13.english_reference: Even after a certain rate every day

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ דְבַר י֣וֹם בְּ י֗וֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατὰ τὸν λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: ut per síngulos dies offerrétur in eo
traditions.KJV: Even after a certain rate every day ,

13.english_reference: offering according to the commandment of Moses

traditions.WLC: לְ הַעֲלוֹת֙ כְּ מִצְוַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀναφέρειν κατὰ τὰς ἐντολὰς Μωυσῆ
traditions.VUL: iuxta præcéptum Móysi
traditions.KJV: offering according to the commandment of Moses ,

13.english_reference: on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts

traditions.WLC: לַ שַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְ לֶ֣ חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וְ לַ מּ֣וֹעֲד֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: ἐν τοῖς σαββάτοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς μησὶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ,
traditions.VUL: in sábbatis et in caléndis , et in festis diébus ,
traditions.KJV: on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts ,

traditions.WLC: שָׁל֥וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּ שָּׁנָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: ter per annum ,
traditions.KJV: three times in the year , [ even ]

13.english_reference: [ even ] in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles

traditions.WLC: בְּ חַ֧ג הַ מַּצּ֛וֹת וּ בְ חַ֥ג הַ שָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּ בְ חַ֥ג הַ סֻּכּֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τῶν ἀζύμων , ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τῶν ἑβδομάδων , ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τῶν σκηνῶν .
traditions.VUL: id est , in solemnitáte azymórum , et in solemnitáte hebdomadárum , et in solemnitáte tabernaculórum .
traditions.KJV: in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles .

14.english_reference: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמֵ֣ד כְּ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּֽוִיד אָ֠בִי ו אֶת מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַ כֹּהֲנִ֜ים עַל עֲבֹדָתָ֗ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησεν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν Δαυεὶδ τὰς διαιρέσεις τῶν ἱερέων κατὰ τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Et constítuit iuxta dispositiónem David patris sui offícia sacerdótum in ministériis suis ,
traditions.KJV: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service ,

14.english_reference: and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֣ם עַל מִ֠שְׁמְרוֹתָ ם לְ הַלֵּ֨ל וּ לְ שָׁרֵ֜ת נֶ֤גֶד הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἐπὶ τὰς φυλακὰς αὐτῶν τοῦ λειτουργεῖν καὶ αἰνεῖν κατέναντι τῶν ἱερέων
traditions.VUL: et Levítas in órdine suo , ut laudárent et ministrárent coram sacerdótibus
traditions.KJV: and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests ,

14.english_reference: as the duty of every day required

traditions.WLC: לִ דְבַר י֣וֹם בְּ יוֹמ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὸν λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: iuxta ritum uniuscuiúsque diéi ,
traditions.KJV: as the duty of every day required :

14.english_reference: the porters also by their courses at every gate

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ שּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים בְּ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ ם לְ שַׁ֣עַר וָ שָׁ֑עַר
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ κατὰ τὰς διαιρέσεις αὐτῶν εἰς πὐλην καὶ πὐλην ,
traditions.VUL: et ianitóres in divisiónibus suis per portam et portam :
traditions.KJV: the porters also by their courses at every gate :

14.english_reference: for so had David the man of God commanded

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כֵ֔ן מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֥יד אִישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὕτως ἐντολαὶ Δαυεὶδ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: sic enim præcéperat David homo Dei .
